title: Classic Margherita Pizza
instructions: Preheat your oven (and pizza stone if available) to 500°F (260°C).
Stretch out the dough on a lightly floured surface into a 12-inch circle.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over the crust, leaving a small border.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
Garnish with fresh basil leaves, drizzle olive oil, and sprinkle sea salt before slicing.
